title: Arcana Core Field: Core Loop
summary: Turn arcane discoveries into shared records that other addons can safely consume.

blocks.title: Discover
blocks.body: Find or create an arcane signal, then record the relevant definition with stable ids, tags, and player-facing context.

blocks.title: Publish
blocks.body: Expose the record through registered providers so Index, Grimoire, Lens, HoloMap, and MissionCore can decide what to show.

blocks.title: Act
blocks.body: Let gameplay modules consume the shared record for rituals, spells, curses, relic behavior, and route progress without creating hard dependencies.

blocks.title: Loop Check
blocks.body: Run the loop once more only if the return path, inventory space, and next upgrade are clear.
